contractOrigin: Reconstructed from user mission on 2026-10-30; no CrossCue ledger present in current workspace, searched local project roots or related second-feature repository. Existing Second Feature preserved.

checks.title: Resolve eight real identities
checks.expected: Live adapter resolves four artists and four exact movie versions; IDs recorded.

checks.title: Validate both directional Insights queries
checks.expected: Live artist→movie and movie→artist queries use current supported parameters.

checks.title: Enforce fixed-shortlist coverage
checks.expected: Returned IDs belong to targets; duplicates and missing targets are explicit.

checks.title: Preserve contextual provenance
checks.expected: Every displayed rank retains signal, shortlist, endpoint, timestamp and response hash; no audience probabilities or cross-query score averages.

checks.title: Handle provider failures
checks.expected: Invalid credentials, rate limits, timeout, malformed/missing results fail clearly without fabricated fallback.

checks.title: Prove live consequential pair
checks.expected: Real Qloo-supported pair yields two feasible different optimal schedules through actual adapter and engine.

checks.title: Declare complete festival and domains
checks.expected: Eight sessions, four music/four film, two rooms, durations, turnover, domains and locks are explicit.

checks.title: Exact lexicographic optimizer
checks.expected: Exhaustive oracle verifies hard constraints, moved count, displacement and canonical ties in declared finite domain.

checks.title: Independent schedule validator
checks.expected: Separate validation rejects duplicate, missing, out-of-domain, room, turnover, lock and protected-pair violations.

checks.title: Bounded tool-using agent
checks.expected: Typed validated tools drive read, resolve, rank, consequence test, ask, repair and explanation with trace and bounded calls/steps.

checks.title: Isolated versioned organizer persistence
checks.expected: Each visitor has durable separate state; optimistic version checks reject stale/concurrent writes and reload preserves decisions.

checks.title: Preview and explicit apply
checks.expected: Protect/Allow/Defer work; preview has no mutation, explicit confirmation commits validated exact preview and audit trail.

checks.title: Understandable operations screen
checks.expected: Real desktop journey shows time-positioned two-room timetable, type distinctions and clear primary task.

checks.title: Evidence inspector
checks.expected: Working inspector distinguishes fictional schedule from real Qloo identities/ranks and explains limitations/context.

checks.title: Branch comparison and change preview
checks.expected: Judge sees conflict, both feasible outcomes, movement count, displacement, before/after and exact changes.

checks.title: Complete interaction states
checks.expected: Loading, empty, failure, success, no-question and infeasible states exercised with useful recovery.

checks.title: Accessibility
checks.expected: Keyboard journey, names/focus, semantic controls, contrast, reduced motion and automated accessibility checks pass.

checks.title: Responsive mobile journey
checks.expected: Real mobile browser completes analyze, decide, preview, apply and export without clipping or inaccessible controls.

checks.title: Consequential question filter
checks.expected: Both branches compared from identical baseline and protections; same schedules or infeasible branches excluded.

checks.title: Qloo affects candidate priority
checks.expected: Real contextual ranks causally change candidate ordering/selection, with reproducible evidence.

checks.title: Why this question
checks.expected: Working explanation shows prioritization policy, evidence limits and concrete branch differences.

checks.title: Discarded alternatives
checks.expected: All evaluated alternatives have inspectable reasons including same schedule, unsupported, already decided and infeasible.

checks.title: Strict question budget
checks.expected: At most two presented questions per run; Defer consumes budget and repeated/reload requests do not bypass it.

checks.title: Useful stopping behavior
checks.expected: Zero-question and fully locked paths stop with explanation; no forced unnecessary rearrangement.

checks.title: Frozen fair benchmark protocol
checks.expected: Same frozen festival, hard constraints, two-question budget, engine and simulated decision policy for all selectors.

checks.title: Qloo-assisted benchmark arm
checks.expected: Run selector against captured real Qloo provenance, report actual questions, feasible branches and repairs.

checks.title: Metadata-only benchmark arm
checks.expected: Independent metadata selector sees only declared non-Qloo metadata; no derived labels/ranks leak.

checks.title: Blind LLM-only benchmark arm
checks.expected: Actual isolated LLM generation uses no Qloo-derived inputs; prompt/output and model provenance recorded.

checks.title: Reproducible metrics
checks.expected: Script reproduces question/actionability/validity/moves/displacement and records runtime/API calls with limits.

checks.title: Honest comparison
checks.expected: Compact actual results include ties/losses and do not infer real attendee satisfaction/revenue/overlap.

checks.title: Reviewer A Qloo correctness
checks.expected: Independent review reproduces wrong identity/missing results/auth/rate issues; fixes verified, no critical remaining.

checks.title: Reviewer B scheduling
checks.expected: Independent oracle/reproductions cover locks, infeasible protection, same branches, invalid and duplicate placements.

checks.title: Reviewer C UX
checks.expected: Independent real-browser desktop/mobile/keyboard/reduced-motion and export review; material defects fixed.

checks.title: Reviewer D idea and judging
checks.expected: Independent skeptical originality/organizer value review grounded in competing workflows and demonstrated behavior.

checks.title: Reviewer E security and deployment
checks.expected: Independent reproduction covers visitor isolation, stale state, injection, secrets, quotas and public release.

checks.title: Invalid tool/model outputs and injection
checks.expected: Runtime validation rejects unauthorized tools, malformed outputs and external instruction injection; no model direct apply.

checks.title: Single preserved 60-check ledger
checks.expected: Original ledger preserved if found; otherwise one reconstructed ten-phase 60-check contract maps all user gates.

checks.title: Evidence completeness
checks.expected: Every VERIFIED entry includes implementation, command/interaction, expected, observed, evidence path and tested revision.

checks.title: Synchronized machine and Markdown status
checks.expected: Generator and verification command detect mismatch, missing IDs and unsupported VERIFIED assertions.

checks.title: Release provenance
checks.expected: Source revision, tested revision, deployed revision and evidence manifest are unambiguous and consistent.

checks.title: No mock substitution
checks.expected: Live gates reject fixture evidence; UI screenshots cannot satisfy complete workflow gates.

checks.title: Final acceptance reconciliation
checks.expected: All twelve final acceptance conditions map to passing mandatory checks; unresolved gaps remain explicit.

checks.title: Free authorized external hosting
checks.expected: Public external app runs backend; existing free access verified and no paid upgrades/overage added.

checks.title: Public live Qloo path
checks.expected: Fresh anonymous browser resolves/loads real Qloo evidence and completes core journey with no judge API key.

checks.title: Durable budget and rate limits
checks.expected: Server enforces shared API budget, per-visitor limits and concurrent request control beyond a single process.

checks.title: Secret and privacy protection
checks.expected: Source, history, bundle, logs, endpoints and export reviewed; server credentials and visitor tokens not exposed.

checks.title: Hosted persistence and isolation
checks.expected: Fresh independent visitors cannot read/change each other; reload and stale decision handling verified publicly.

checks.title: Exact release verification
checks.expected: Exact deployed tested source passes public desktop/mobile journey, major controls, export validation and failure behavior.

checks.title: Public licensed repository
checks.expected: Public repository contains complete tested source and approved open-source license visible to GitHub.

checks.title: Reproducible README and architecture
checks.expected: Setup, Qloo config, finite-domain guarantees, state boundaries, tests, benchmark, deployment and demo URL accurate.

checks.title: Truthful compelling submission copy
checks.expected: Description covers problem, distinctive mechanism, Qloo, agent, guarantees, evidence, limitations and impact without unsupported claims.

checks.title: Current form and start date
checks.expected: Latest required fields recorded; actual project start date sourced; no invented answers or missing links.

checks.title: Real product screenshots
checks.expected: Screenshots capture actual deployed baseline, evidence, decision and repaired states; assets licensed.

checks.title: Submission handoff/status
checks.expected: Complete release-matching form answers prepared; actual Devpost status explicitly verified, submission only within authorization.

checks.title: Fresh first-time demo
checks.expected: Independent skeptical visitor understands problem, Qloo contribution, consequence and result without reading README.

checks.title: Technological implementation score
checks.expected: Evidence-based /5 score and strongest deadline-feasible fix; no unwarranted perfect score.

checks.title: Design score
checks.expected: Evidence-based /5 score and strongest deadline-feasible fix; complete behavior substantiated.

checks.title: Potential impact score
checks.expected: Evidence-based /5 score distinguishes demonstrated workflow utility from unvalidated market/customer claims.

checks.title: Quality of idea score
checks.expected: Evidence-based /5 score explains non-obvious Qloo use and limits of originality claim.

checks.title: Fix, rerun and final readiness
checks.expected: Substantive defects fixed/retested; no unresolved critical review defect; final report contains exact checks, URLs, commits, evidence, tests, benchmark and actual submission state.
